description: This PHP source file defines a class InvalidRegexPatternRule that implements a PHPStan rule to validate regex patterns used in static calls, specifically targeting regex functions like match, isMatch, grep, replace, and split within the Composer Pcre namespace.

classes.name: InvalidRegexPatternRule
classes.description: A PHPStan rule class that checks the validity of regex patterns used in specific static method calls within PHP code.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Returns the type of PHP parser node this rule processes, which is StaticCall.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a given node to extract regex patterns and validate them, returning errors for invalid patterns.

methods.name: extractPatterns
methods.description: Extracts regex pattern strings from a static call node if it matches certain criteria and is using specific regex functions.

methods.description: Validates a regex pattern string by attempting to match it and catching any exceptions or errors, returning an error message if invalid.
